title: Virtual Card Management: Setting Spending Limits Per Card
summary: Explains how to set and edit per-card spending limits for virtual cards in the card Details panel. Limits can be set from $55 to $150,000, with selectable reset periods (per transaction, daily, or monthly); changes take effect immediately, and includes category-based troubleshooting for declines.
